public_boundary_notes: The cloud host uses ParticlePrior: Recipe.make_prior removes standardize before construction. Do not interpret standardize=True as normalized latent-cloud reads.
DV12 kernel width uses raw prior coordinate spread and nearest nonzero support clipping; output_noise=False still retains this latent perturbation.

G and prior are jointly updated from the same GAN backward pass; this tuple also halves the learned-output-noise role. Nominal D/prior preservation does not hold their realized gradients, rates, clocks or paths fixed.
The API runner retains observations and only the terminal checkpoint; step() return losses are not retained in its loop. Missing per-update loss/rate/intermediate-state evidence must remain missing.
KA2 critic surprise reads decayed exp_avg_sq, while AMSGrad actual step/guard denominator uses max_exp_avg_sq. Keep these numerical functions distinct.

signatures.available: Saved step0/25/... image arrays and original metrics; final G gradient/optimizer state
signatures.can_establish: The retained law and local output sensitivity fail or recover at those checkpoints
signatures.cannot_establish: Unsaved updates1..24 force sequence or which owner caused saturation
signatures.quantity: Patch brightness, pixel-to-blank RMS, local sigmoid sensitivity p*(1-p), rejected mass/HQ and nearest-valid-mode mass

signatures.available: Saved final raw prior z, EMA-prior, controller latent bandwidth/last applications, row evidence/birth-death counters
signatures.can_establish: Terminal geometry differences and recorded discrete intervention activity
signatures.cannot_establish: Prior path displacement from initialization without saved initial state, output attribution with fixed G, or a causal prior-only effect
signatures.quantity: Final table geometry and differences between matched-shape endpoint tables, latent perturbation radius/clip summaries and actual row-event counters

signatures.available: Final assigned optimizer LRs, initial role rates, stationarity testers and controller payoff_error
signatures.can_establish: Rate assignment and the known source control law at retained endpoint
signatures.cannot_establish: Time-integrated D learning speed or per-update G/D balance from a smoothed endpoint
signatures.quantity: Effective-to-nominal role ratios; reciprocal-square D damping with boundary lag disclosed

signatures.available: Final previous_generator_gradient and Adam exp_avg/exp_avg_sq/max_exp_avg_sq/step, group betas and LR
signatures.can_establish: Small local sensitivity, nonzero recovery gradient and retained moment scales
signatures.cannot_establish: Initial-cause attribution, recovered outputs under a different optimizer, or controller surprise computed from the wrong max moment
signatures.quantity: Layerwise gradient norms and actual denominator scales, signed output-bias gradient

signatures.available: Every image observation served_averaged flag, final policy/backend/EMA/guard state
signatures.can_establish: Which law was sampled and which recorded interventions occurred
signatures.cannot_establish: An unmeasured EMA grade or full Atlas/E22 equivalence from matching fast arrays
signatures.quantity: Actual chosen public fast or averaged law and whether recorded birth/reopen/surprise counters changed

trial_policy: No further shared-config trial is declared in advance. First analyze the immutable new pair. A later sole-field prior or optimizer/penalty contrast requires measured support, exact public admission/capacity/source bindings, full16 denominator and an explicitly finite remaining budget. No unchanged-profile/seed-only repeats.
